title: The derived stalk of a supplied etale constant chart
statement: Let X be any scheme and B any commutative coefficient ring, with the coefficient-sized etale model of [def-sfb-coefficient-etale-derived-stalk]. Let K be an intrinsic derived object, W an object of that site, and M a cochain complex of B-modules supplying a local model [def-sfb-coefficient-fixed-derived-models]. Given an algebraically closed field Ω, a geometric point x:Spec Ω→X, and a lift t of x to the underlying etale scheme of W, the algebraic derived object Q(M) is isomorphic to coefficientEtaleDerivedStalk(X,B,x)(K). No boundedness or finiteness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tag 094G, a chosen local constant cochain model; Etale Cohomology Tags 03PT and 04EQ, its geometric stalk, as used in the individual-chart part of Tag 09BI.

proof.text: Undo the AsSmall equivalence on global and slice sheaves. The supplied lift defines z in the fiber of the etale object W. The equivalence of categories of elements for the point on the slice, followed by Over.forget of the pointed object, is initial. Its opposite is final, so the canonical colimit isomorphism identifies slice restriction followed by the slice stalk with the original stalk.

For the slice point, compose sheafification adjunction with its skyscraper-sheaf adjunction. Its right adjoint is the skyscraper-presheaf functor, so uniqueness of left adjoints identifies sheafification followed by the stalk with presheaf stalk. The pointed neighborhood category is filtered and hence connected. Its constant-presheaf colimit is the given module, naturally in the module. Transport this natural isomorphism through the AsSmall slice equivalence.

The slice stalk is exact and additive. Apply its induced derived functor to the supplied local-model isomorphism. Exact-functor composition and natural-isomorphism descent identify its two ends with the specified derived etale stalk and Q(M).

lean.statement:
theorem coefficient_etale_chart_stalk
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing B]
    (K : ConstantCompletion.D
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B))
    (W : smallModelComparisonEtaleSite.{u, v} X)
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} B) ℤ)
    (hM : CoefficientFixedLocalModel (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B K W M)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ (AsSmall.down.obj W : X.Etale).left)
    (ht : t ≫ (AsSmall.down.obj W : X.Etale).hom = x) :
    Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M ≅ (coefficientEtaleDerivedStalk X B x).obj K)
